item.title: [LU-20902] sanity test_413m/418: weighted round-robin MDT allocation leaves inode counts unbalanced
item.description:
Both test_413m and test_418 failed together in the sanity run of
test_group review-dne-zfs-part-1, session
https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sessions/4fbbc1db-4d3e-4135-a359-33083963b0bd,
on patchset 3 of change 69427 (LU-17601 lmv: pick mkdir MDT by
weighted round-robin), the last of an unmerged stack (changes
69423-69427) reworking the MDT QoS weighted round-robin allocator.

test_413m: "MDT0 has 65 2nd stripes, want 70", outside the
+-MDSCOUNT tolerance the test allows for the weighted round-robin
placement of the second stripe.

test_418 in the same session: df -i reports 1245595 total inodes
while lfs df -i's per-target sum is 1286040; MDT0002's own total of
159289 is far below the other three MDTs' 356126-393147, so df and
lfs df disagree on the aggregate.

Neither is new to patchset 3: the same two subtests fail with the
same signatures on the series' earlier changes 69423 ("MDT0 has 68
2nd stripes, want 59") and 69425 ("MDT0 has 66 2nd stripes, want
72"; df/lfs df inode mismatch), before 69427's own diff is even
applied, so this is not something 69427 introduces. The per-target
inode-count disagreement in test_418 looks tied to the dynamic
bytes-per-inode weight estimate 69425 (LU-16678) added for QoS
weighting, which likely also feeds the per-MDT weight test_413m
checks; no existing ticket describes either failure.

Raised by Patch Watcher run pw-engineer-69427-ps3-2250f0fafdb6 on https://review.whamcloud.com/69427

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are closed can be reopened.

comments.comment:
Patrick-Bot: Patch Watcher raised this ticket in error.

sanity test_413m and test_418 fail on the unmerged series this ticket names (changes 69423-69427), in session after session and on retest, and nowhere else: no branch run and no change outside the series has failed them in the last 30 days. They are that series' own bugs, from its weighted round-robin MDT allocation rework, not a separate problem for triage. The run read "not caused by 69427's own diff" as "not this patch's", but the series lands together, so the fix belongs in the series.

The eleven Maloo links to this ticket, all on change 69427's patchset 3, have been rejected so those failures block landing again. Patch Watcher no longer links, retests or raises a ticket for a failure confined to a change's own series.

This ticket can be closed.
